findings.title: Cannot finish by day 45
findings.detail: The earliest the work can finish is day 52, 7 days late. Ruth has 52 days of work and can only do one task at a time.
findings.quote: The festival is on the evening of day 45, counting from our kickoff meeting, and everything on the task list below has to be done by then.

findings.title: No owner for "Arrange extra bins and a litter-pick team for the night"
findings.detail: Nobody is named for this task, so nobody is accountable for it. The schedule lets it run alongside other work, which may be optimistic.
findings.quote: Arrange extra bins and a litter-pick team for the night

findings.title: Tasks appear only in the notes
findings.detail: Four tasks are described only in the notes and are missing from the task table: arranging the stage lighting and PA hire (Ruth, 3 days), collecting and storing the finished lanterns (Priya, 2 days), building the finale frame (Gareth, 8 days), and writing the press release and social media posts (Tom, 3 days). They need adding to the task list with owners and durations so they are tracked.
findings.quote: Ruth will also arrange the hire of the stage lighting and a PA system for the green.

findings.title: Notes add dependencies the table leaves out
findings.detail: The table shows the risk assessment and the insurance as independent of first aid, but the notes make the risk assessment wait for first aid cover and the insurance wait for the risk assessment. The notes also make printing wait for the road closure approval, which the table does not show. These need reconciling in the table.
findings.quote: Ruth will write the risk assessment once Gareth has confirmed the first aid cover, because the council's template asks for the first aid arrangements to be written into it.

findings.title: Sponsorship target may not cover costs
findings.detail: The plan hopes for £2,500 in sponsorship plus a £500 grant, but the biggest costs (lantern materials, road closure, toilets and barriers, stage lighting) are not costed. The lantern materials and finale frame both depend on sponsorship being in, so a shortfall would delay them.
findings.quote: We are hoping to raise £2,500 in sponsorship, and the council's small events grant gives us £500.

findings.title: Durations estimated for note-only tasks
findings.detail: The four tasks that appear only in the notes have no duration in the table. Durations of 3, 2, 8 and 3 days have been taken from the notes where stated and estimated where not; these should be confirmed.
findings.quote: He thinks that is three days.

findings.title: Ruth holds most of the critical tasks
findings.detail: Ruth owns the route agreement, road closure, risk assessment, insurance, band bookings, food stalls, steward recruitment and briefing, and stage lighting hire. This concentration is a single point of failure if she is unavailable.
findings.quote: Ruth Marsh, our chair, has very kindly agreed to look after the permissions and the bookings again.
